subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the 13 exact action-pin updates be accepted as one security-sensitive group after final-head checks and direct Codex contract verification, or should token, publishing, scanning, and Codex action families be reviewed separately?
rationale: These actions execute with materially different secrets and permissions, and repository policy reserves security-labeled workflow changes for explicit maintainer judgment.

options.title: Validate grouped update
options.body: Confirm each upstream release delta, complete direct Codex inspection, and merge the exact pins together after relevant final-head checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive families
options.body: Separate token, publishing, CodeQL, and Codex updates so each permission boundary can be validated and landed independently.

options.title: Defer the group
options.body: Leave the current pins in place if any upstream delta or final-head workflow result cannot be reviewed confidently.

recommendation.title: Validate grouped update
recommendation.body: Confirm each upstream release delta, complete direct Codex inspection, and merge the exact pins together after relevant final-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available repository-history signal connects this person to the release workflow, which carries the highest-impact publishing changes in the group.
